newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 18 trln rbls in bills, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 18 trln rbls in bills, bonds.

text.p: The Russian Finance Ministry will offer eight trillion roubles in 364-day GKO discount Treasury bills (series 21079) and 10 trillion roubles in 728-day OFZ interest-bearing bonds (series 24015) on July 16, the central bank said on Wednesday.
Full details of the auction follow:

Full details of the bonds auction:
In money terms the first coupon rate is 88,457 roubles.

On July 16 the Finance Ministry will also pay 361.7 trillion roubles and repay 4.81 trillion roubles on series 24008 bond on a voluntary basis. It will also repay 22069 7.48 trillion roubles on a maturing 161-day bills (series 22069).
